cards.ex: I'm taking vitamin C to ward off the flu this winter.
cards.exUz: Men bu qishda grippning oldini olish uchun S vitaminini qabul qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki muammoni boshlanishidan oldin to'xtatish yoki bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: There's a nasty bug going around the office; half the staff are sick.
cards.exUz: Ofisda yomon bir virus tarqalgan; xodimlarning yarmi kasal.
cards.uzDef: Juda yoqimsiz yoki og'ir kasallikni keltirib chiqaruvchi virus yoki infeksiya.

cards.ex: After the accident, his condition was touch-and-go for a few days.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin, uning ahvoli bir necha kun davomida xavfli edi.
cards.uzDef: Natija noaniq bo'lgan, o'lim xavfi bor vaziyat.

cards.ex: Surgery was a quick fix, but now I need physical therapy.
cards.exUz: Jarrohlik - tez yechim edi, lekin endi menga fizioterapiya kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni tezda, lekin ko'pincha vaqtincha hal qilish usuli.

cards.ex: I've been feeling out of sorts all week; I think I'm getting a cold.
cards.exUz: Men butun hafta o'zimni yomon his qilyapman; menimcha, shamollayapman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini odatdagidek his qilmaslik, kasal yoki xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: The doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics for my infection.
cards.exUz: Doktor infeksiyam uchun antibiotiklar kursini buyurdi.
cards.uzDef: Dori-darmon yoki davolanishning ma'lum bir davri.

cards.ex: After the surgery, she's finally on the road to recovery.
cards.exUz: Jarrohlikdan keyin, u nihoyat sog'ayish yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan yoki jarohatdan asta-sekin tuzalib borish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Regular exercise helps to keep illnesses at bay.
cards.exUz: Muntazam mashqlar kasalliklarni uzoqroq ushlab turishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon narsaning sodir bo'lishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik yoki uni nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: After the heart transplant, he felt like he had a new lease on life.
cards.exUz: Yurak transplantatsiyasidan so'ng, u o'zini yangi hayotga ega bo'lganday his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir kasallikdan so'ng yoki katta o'zgarishlardan keyin yangi energiya va hayotga bo'lgan ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: The disease was nipped in the bud thanks to early diagnosis.
cards.exUz: Kasallik erta tashxis tufayli tomirida quritildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir rivojlanishiga yoki muammoga aylanishiga yo'l qo'yilmasdan, erta to'xtatildi.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit off color today, so I'm staying home.
cards.exUz: Men bugun biroz rangim o'chgan, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal.

cards.ex: I know you're scared, but you need to get a grip and think clearly.
cards.exUz: Qo'rqayotganingni bilaman, lekin o'zingni tutishing va aniq o'ylashing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z hissiyotlarini nazorat qilish, tinchlanish.

cards.ex: The new treatment offers a ray of hope for patients with this disease.
cards.exUz: Yangi davolash usuli ushbu kasallik bilan og'rigan bemorlar uchun umid nurini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Umidning kichik alomati, qiyin vaziyatda yaxshi bo'lish ehtimoli.

cards.ex: Despite her age, she's still in good nick and very active.
cards.exUz: Uning yoshiga qaramay, u hali ham yaxshi holatda va juda faol.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi holatda, sog'lom va sog'-salomat.

cards.ex: I got a clean bill of health after my annual check-up.
cards.exUz: Yillik tekshiruvimdan so'ng sog'lom degan ma'lumot oldim.
cards.uzDef: Tibbiy ko'rikdan so'ng sog'ligingiz yaxshi ekanligini ko'rsatadigan natija.

cards.ex: The doctor said the virus just has to run its course.
cards.exUz: Doktor virusning o'z vaqtini o'tashi kerakligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki jarayonning tabiiy ravishda tugashiga ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: I think I have a touch of the flu; I'm feeling achy.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, menda ozgina gripp bor; tanam og'riyapti.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikning yengil shakli.

cards.ex: It took me a while, but I'm finally back on my feet after surgery.
cards.exUz: Menga biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi, lekin men nihoyat jarrohlikdan keyin yana oyoqqa turdim.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan keyin sog'ayish va normal hayotga qaytish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets worse.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni yomonlashishidan oldin boshida yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo kattalashishidan oldin uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: She's been in the pink ever since she started exercising.
cards.exUz: U mashq qila boshlaganidan beri juda sog'lom va baxtli.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va baxtli, yaxshi ahvolda.

cards.ex: The medication helped to ease the pain after the surgery.
cards.exUz: Dori operatsiyadan keyin og'riqni kamaytirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Og'riqni kamroq sezishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: He's a bit long in the tooth to be playing professional sports.
cards.exUz: U professional sport bilan shug'ullanish uchun biroz qarib qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Keksa yoshda bo'lgan, qarigan.

cards.ex: You should take his medical advice with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Uning tibbiy maslahatlarini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: To'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: I haven't been sick all year, touch wood!
cards.exUz: Men butun yil davomida kasal bo'lmadim, omad tilayman!
cards.uzDef: Omad tilash uchun yog'ochga tegish odati (yomon narsa ro'y bermasligi uchun).

cards.ex: Despite his age, he remains hale and hearty.
cards.exUz: U yoshiga qaramay, sog'lom va baquvvatligicha qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom, kuchli va yaxshi ahvolda.

cards.ex: The loud noise made me jump out of my skin.
cards.exUz: Balq ovoz meni juda qo'rqitib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib ketish, vahimaga tushish.

cards.ex: The rash should clear up in a couple of days with this cream.
cards.exUz: Toshma bu krem bilan bir necha kunda tuzalib ketishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki muammo yaxshi tomonga o'zgarib, yo'q bo'lib ketishi.

cards.ex: He's a shadow of his former self since the surgery.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan keyin u o'zining avvalgi holatining soyasi bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi holatidan ancha yomonroq ahvolda bo'lish, ayniqsa sog'liqda.

cards.ex: The surgery is a long shot, but it's his only hope.
cards.exUz: Operatsiya - ehtimoli past, lekin bu uning yagona umidi.
cards.uzDef: Umid kam bo'lgan, amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Put a coat on, you'll catch your death out there!
cards.exUz: Palto kiying, u yerda qotib qolasiz!
cards.uzDef: Sovuqda qotib, kasal bo'lib qolish ehtimoli juda yuqori.
